name: skill-management
description: Authoring guardrails for SKILL.md files: a commit-time structural validator (catches frontmatter that would silently truncate from the harness's skill listing or fail strict-YAML parsing) plus a behavioral-equivalence audit via /skill-review. Install at project scope in repos that author SKILL.md files. Needs bash 5.2 or newer first on the PATH Claude Code starts with (macOS: brew install bash) and Claude Code 2.1.295 or newer.
